isReady.description:
Whether the column used in {@link PkgInference.Vertex.Processed#parentMetricName} is ready to have a metric
computed over it. The column is not ready if its metric parent still lives on an
{@link PkgInference.Vertex.UnevaluatedMetric} vertex, and true otherwise.

excluded.description:
Whether the column used in {@link PkgInference.Vertex.Processed#parentMetricName} is excluded from metric
computations. A column is excluded when it has been used in specific metric operations, such as the column
grouped by in a call to {@link Data#groupby} or the column resampled on in {@link Data#resample}.

@see PkgInference.Vertex.UnevaluatedMetric#excludedFieldNames

name.description:
The name of the metric parent. If null, column is either not ready, or has no parent metric (and thus will be a
{@link SimpleMetric}) -- use {@link PkgInference.ParentMetricNameResult#isReady} to differentiate.
